world.description: Five Rube-Goldberg machines wired into one physics chain reaction.

intro.objective: Start the chain and watch dominoes, a marble, a wrecking ball, an avalanche and a strike set each other off.
intro.tagline: Five machines. One push. Every bounce simulated and checked.
intro.title: Chain Reaction

world.name: Chain Reaction

rules.description: Machine 2: nudge the marble off the tower

then.text: Press SPACE to start the chain — or click a glowing button.

rules.description: Starts by itself if nobody presses a key

then.text: Five machines, one chain reaction. Press R to watch it again.
